batch.desc.en: Every conversation, grouped by Workspace. Under each row sit its subagents and its forked conversations, expandable level by level. Ticking a row takes everything below it; ticking a subagent alone deletes only that subagent. This cannot be undone.
batch.desc.zh: 按工作区分组列出每个会话的家族树：一行下面是它的子智能体与派生对话，可以逐层展开。勾选一行会连同它下面的一切一起删除；只勾某个子智能体，就只删它。删除不可撤销。

batch.tip.en: Tip: click to select the whole family; double-click to select only this conversation.
batch.tip.zh: 提示：单击选择整个会话族，双击仅选择当前会话。

batch.orphanWarning.en: Deleting a main conversation while keeping its children leaves them without a parent; they will appear under a “deleted” placeholder in the bulk view.
batch.orphanWarning.zh: 删除主会话但保留子会话时，保留的子会话会失去父节点，之后在批量页显示在“已删除”占位父下。

batch.confirmStop.zh: 停止并删除 {n} 个会话

batch.workspaceAll.en: Select every conversation in this Workspace
batch.workspaceAll.zh: 选中这个工作区的全部会话

batch.deletePartial.zh: {n} 个删除失败，其余已删除。

batch.stoppingNote.en: Confirming stops the unfinished work in these conversations first, then deletes them.
batch.stoppingNote.zh: 确认后会先停掉这些会话里未结束的工作，再删除。

batch.unknown.en: The whole conversation list could not be read; deleting is still possible.
batch.unknown.zh: 读不到整个会话列表，仍可直接删除。

batch.stale.zh: 记录已不存在，无法删除

batch.staleHint.en: This conversation has no log left on disk, so deleting it would fail; remove it from the sidebar instead.
batch.staleHint.zh: 这个会话的日志已经不在磁盘上，删除会失败；要让它从列表消失，请从侧栏移除。

batch.staleCount.en: {n} of them have no log left on disk and cannot be deleted.
batch.staleCount.zh: 其中 {n} 个会话只剩列表记录，日志已不在磁盘上，无法删除。

usage.offHint.en: Usage is off; session logs are not read.
usage.offHint.zh: 用量统计已关闭，不再读取会话日志。

usage.cacheNote.en: Session cache: the parsed result DSH keeps per conversation (under storages/session_projcache in the DSH data directory), so logs are not replayed every time. Deleting a conversation removes only its own cache record.
usage.cacheNote.zh: 会话缓存：DSH 为每个会话保存的解析结果（在 DSH 数据目录的 storages/session_projcache 下），用来避免每次重放日志。删除会话时只清理该会话对应的缓存记录，不影响其他会话。

dialog.desc.en: “{title}” will be deleted permanently: its session log, workspace account and projection cache are removed. This cannot be undone.
dialog.desc.zh: 将永久删除“{title}”：会话日志、工程记录与投影缓存都会被移除，无法撤销。

dialog.running.en: This conversation still has unfinished work:
dialog.running.zh: 这个会话还有未结束的工作：

dialog.runningHint.en: Confirming stops that work first, then deletes the conversation.
dialog.runningHint.zh: 确认后会先停掉这些工作，再删除这个会话。

dialog.open.en: The Harness still holds it open (it may be showing in a window or tab). Deleting removes it from the list at once.
dialog.open.zh: 它当前仍被 Harness 占用（可能开在某个窗口或标签里）。删除后它会立刻从列表消失。

dialog.unknown.en: Its current state could not be read; deleting is still possible.
dialog.unknown.zh: 读不到它的当前状态，仍可直接删除。

dialog.descendants.derived.zh: {n} 个由它派生（fork）出来的对话

dialog.tip.en: Tip: a click selects only this conversation; use Select all above for the whole family.
dialog.tip.zh: 提示：单击仅选择当前会话；要选整个会话族，用上方的全选。

dialog.orphanWarning.en: Unselected children stay, but they lose their parent and later appear under a “deleted” placeholder in the bulk view.
dialog.orphanWarning.zh: 未选中的子会话不会被删除，但会与主会话断开，之后在批量页显示在“已删除”占位父下。

dialog.expandHint.en: Click a group title to collapse it

dialog.truncated.en: There are {n}; only the first {shown} are listed.
dialog.truncated.zh: 共 {n} 个，下面只列出前 {shown} 个。

dialog.maxDeletable.en: At most {max} can be deleted at once — select in batches.
dialog.maxDeletable.zh: 一次最多删除 {max} 个，请分批选择。

dialog.warnings.en: These leads could not be read, so the family may be incomplete:
dialog.warnings.zh: 下面这些线索没读到，家族可能不完整：

dialog.confirmStopCount.zh: 停止并删除 {n} 个会话

dialog.folder.zh: 打开这个节点对应的本地目录

dialog.folderNone.en: This node has no folder of its own
dialog.folderNone.zh: 这个节点没有独立的本地目录

dialog.opened.zh: 已在文件管理器中打开

dialog.siblingsNote.en: This conversation contains {subagents} subagent and {derived} forked conversation(s).
dialog.siblingsNote.zh: 该会话包含 {subagents} 个子会话和 {derived} 个派生会话。
